content: The map doesn't show tilled soil, but the day advanced. I'll keep the body busy with a longer wait plus a watering pass, then attempt the corridor on day 5. Since the pass opens "morning of day 5", I'll wait enough to reach day 5, then walk the corridor.

args.approach: Day 2 now; pass opens morning of day 5. Water the crops once, then wait out days 2-4, then walk the east corridor (x 11) north to the chest at (11,1).
